products.name: Visa Credit Card
products.description: Our Visa Credit Card offers 6 months of 0% pa on balance transfers. Afterwards you’ll still enjoy a low ongoing interest rate, with the same low rate applying for all purchases and cash advances. You’ll have the ability to make fast payments with Google Pay, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, Garmin Pay and Visa payWave. It’s also highly secure, with microchip technology, 24/7 fraud monitoring, Visa’s Zero Liability policy and Visa Secure for online purchases from participating merchants and payWave. You’ll also be able to temporarily lock your card (if you misplace it), plus block payWave, international and online transactions whenever you need to – using the Mobile Banking App or Internet Banking.

products.name: Workplace Benefits Credit Card
products.description: Our Workplace Benefits Credit Card includes no annual fee, a 0% pa introductory rate for the first six months on purchases, balance transfers and cash advances as well as a low ongoing interest rate after the first 6 months.  You’ll have the ability to make fast payments with Google Pay, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, Garmin Pay and Visa payWave. It’s also highly secure, with microchip technology, 24/7 fraud monitoring, Visa’s Zero Liability policy and Visa Secure for online purchases from participating merchants and payWave. You’ll also be able to temporarily lock your card (if you misplace it), plus block payWave, international and online transactions whenever you need to – using the Mobile Banking App or Internet Banking.

products.name: Education Community Variable Rate Personal Loan
products.description: Our Education Community Variable Rate Personal Loan is is exclusive to current or retired employees of the South Australian education community, students carrying out studies in education, and their eligible immediate family members.  It is an unsecured personal loan. The minimum loan amount is $5,000 and a maximum loan amount of $50,000.

products.name: Bonus Savings Account
products.description: Earn a great bonus rate each month if you make a deposit of any amount and no withdrawals with our Bonus Savings Account. It doesn’t matter if you deposit $1 or $1,000 each month, either way you can earn bonus interest. Best of all, there’s no maximum or minimum balance requirements, so you can have as much or as little as you like sitting in your account.

products.name: Educator+ Account
products.description: A transaction account that pays interest on your entire balance, no matter how many transactions you make. Earn interest while you spend, No minimum balance required for interest to start being paid and Flexible access to funds any time without penalty. This is an exclusive offer for current and retired employees of the South Australian education community, students studying education, and their eligible immediate family members as part of our Knowledge Counts banking benefits.

products.name: Port+ Account
products.description: A transaction account that pays interest on your entire balance, no matter how many transactions you make. Earn interest while you spend, No minimum balance required for interest to start being paid and flexible access to funds any time without penalty. This account is avaialble exclusively to members and employees of the Port Adelaide Football Club. "Subject to eligibility criteria and verification".

products.name: Children's Savings Account
products.description: Our Children’s savings account is for anyone under the age of 18 wanting an account to save or spend. The account rewards good savings behaviours and pays bonus interest if no withdrawals are made and if a deposit is made each month.The account pays interest on up to $50,000 and any amount above this will not earn interest.

products.name: Standard Variable Rate Home Loan Interest Only
products.description: Our Standard Variable Rate Home Loan is ideal for those seeking significant flexibility – a rate that moves with the market and many convenient features.
